gloss: skillful; efficient; deft; having good technique

definitions.gloss: skillful; efficient; deft; adept at handling tasks
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who performs tasks quickly, smoothly, and competently. Emphasizes practical skill and efficiency in execution rather than innate talent.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{手際|てぎわ}が{良|よ}い。
{手際|てぎわ}{良|よ}く{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}る。
スタッフが{手際|てぎわ}{良|よ}く{会場|かいじょう}を{準備|じゅんび}してくれたおかげで、{予定|よてい}{通|どお}り{始|はじ}められた。
examples.english: Thanks to the staff efficiently setting up the venue, we were able to start on schedule.

notes:
{手際|てぎわ} means "skill in handling" or "dexterity" — from {手|て} (hand) + {際|ぎわ} (manner, edge). The expression praises someone's practical ability to get things done smoothly.

USAGE:
Often used adverbially as {手際|てぎわ}{良|よ}く (efficiently, deftly) to modify verbs. The negative {手際|てぎわ}が{悪|わる}い describes clumsy or inefficient work. Common in cooking, work, and service contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}{良|よ}く{片付|かたづ}ける — to tidy up efficiently
- {手際|てぎわ}{良|よ}く{料理|りょうり}する — to cook deftly
- {手際|てぎわ}が{悪|わる}い — clumsy, inefficient
- {手際|てぎわ}の{良|よ}さ — efficiency, deftness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {器用|きよう}な — dexterous, handy (innate manual skill)
- {要領|ようりょう}が{良|よ}い — shrewd, knowing how to get things done (street-smart efficiency)
- {手慣|てな}れた — practiced, experienced (implies familiarity from repetition)
